about: The changeTile classification (the Great Spread spec, section 10; Stage 4c). Every changeTile call in src/ is counted here per file, with what it writes and how the save migration (src/97-spread.js) treats that tile in an old save: placed (refunded as its item), machine (parked round the Dozer Bay), mare (tied at her rail), crop (seed or harvest refunded), story (dropped and made again from quest state by a HOOKS.remake), world (dropped: regrowth, mining, tilling, fires, cleared ground), instance (inside a dungeon or the island: never an overworld diff), test (a self-test that puts back what it changed), migration (the migrations' own parking). tools/changetile-gate.mjs (run by build.sh) fails the build when a file's count differs from this table, when a file not listed calls changeTile, or when a file that makes story tiles (remake names a file) has no HOOKS.remake there. A new quest that changes the world adds a call, so the build stops until the call is classified here: a story tile needs a remake.

06-systems.js.what: world: regrowth, tilling, harvest, a fire; placed: planks, doors, beds, lodestones, workbenches, traps (and picking them up); crop: planting; machine: the walker's wreck, repair, boarding, parking and its wreck; story: the axe taken from the stump (69-axestump's remake)
